mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_event_support( employee_id, event_type, family_relation, target_name, application_date, event_date, requested_amount, event_location, bank_name, account_number, account_holder, approval_status, memo ) VALUES ( #{employeeId}, #{eventType}, #{familyRelation}, #{targetName}, #{applicationDate}, #{eventDate}, #{requestedAmount}, #{eventLocation}, #{bankName}, #{accountNumber}, #{accountHolder}, #{approvalStatus}, #{memo} )
mapper.select:
select ees.*, fa.original_name as savedFileName, fa.extension as savedFileExt, fa.file_id as savedFileId, fa.created_at as savedFileDate, fa.file_size as savedFileSize, from employee_event_support ees left join file_attachment fa on ees.employee_event_support_id = fa.ref_id
where ees.employee_event_support_id = #{eventSupportId}
